question: How does abstention from food during the day affect age and death?
premises: Non-eating by day is prescribed as a means
Age and death are the conditions addressed
The practitioner will go beyond that condition
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome age and death
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply transcending or reaching the end of age-death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome age and death.
